checks.title: Freeze the candidate
checks.procedure: Record Git SHA, dirty patch, web build, native build number, schema version, API version, flags and environment; every result identifies the exact candidate.

checks.title: Inventory every route
checks.procedure: Crawl registered routes and compare with menus, deep links, role gates and public pages; no reachable page is omitted.

checks.title: Inventory every control
checks.procedure: Record visible and accessible labels, role, handler, destination and expected effect for each button, tab, toggle, slider and link; include conditional states.

checks.title: Define supported platforms
checks.procedure: List exact minimum and current supported OS/browser versions on release day; beta coverage is separate from stable release coverage.

checks.title: Name accountable owners
checks.procedure: Assign engineering, QA, design, backend, payments, security and release owners; every defect and blocked test has one responsible person.

checks.title: Create role fixtures
checks.procedure: Provide separate client, artist, supplier/merchant and studio accounts plus free/paid tiers and suspended/incomplete states; do not infer permissions from labels.

checks.title: Define realistic datasets
checks.procedure: Seed empty, typical and large histories, long text, mixed media, failed payments, multiple bookings and unavailable inventory; use synthetic personal data.

checks.title: Record evidence
checks.procedure: Save device, OS, build, reproduction steps, expected/actual result, timestamp, logs and recording; redact secrets and personal details.

checks.title: Separate evidence levels
checks.procedure: Label static review, unit, mocked browser, integrated staging and physical-device results independently; mocked success never establishes service settlement.

checks.title: Handle applicability
checks.procedure: Mark unsupported features N/A with a reason and reviewer; a hidden but reachable feature is not automatically N/A.

checks.title: Retest changed areas
checks.procedure: Invalidate affected sign-offs after code, dependency, schema, configuration or feature-flag changes; rerun critical journeys on the final artifact.

checks.title: Keep defects visible
checks.procedure: Track failures and blocked tests separately from untested checks; a large pass count cannot override an unresolved critical defect.

checks.title: Smallest supported iPhone
checks.procedure: Run every primary journey at the smallest supported logical width and height; no essential control or content becomes unreachable.

checks.title: Typical and large iPhones
checks.procedure: Repeat with safe-area cutouts and home indicator; spacing, scrolling and fixed controls remain correct.

checks.title: Older supported hardware
checks.procedure: Test the oldest supported physical device and OS; memory pressure and lower performance do not hide functional failures.

checks.title: Current stable iOS
checks.procedure: Record exact OS build and test the latest supported stable release; do not substitute a beta or simulator result.

checks.title: Native app installation
checks.procedure: Install the release-signed or TestFlight candidate fresh and upgrade the previous release; both open correct content and preserve valid data.

checks.title: Safari browser mode
checks.procedure: Test expanded/collapsed browser chrome, tab switching and back-forward navigation; the usable viewport remains correct.

checks.title: Installed web app
checks.procedure: Test standalone Home Screen launch, cold start, resumed launch and update; behavior is recorded separately from Safari.

checks.title: Supported secondary browsers
checks.procedure: Test each browser actually supported by the product; do not assume identical behavior merely because engines may be shared.

checks.title: iPad if supported
checks.procedure: Repeat at full width, portrait, landscape and supported window sizes with touch and pointer; no iPhone-only layout assumption breaks navigation.

checks.title: Orientation and display settings
checks.procedure: Rotate during typing, scrolling and checkout; test Display Zoom and large text without losing content or state.

checks.title: Network matrix
checks.procedure: Repeat core flows on Wi-Fi, mobile data, throttled latency, packet loss and offline-to-online transitions; retries remain safe.

checks.title: System interruptions
checks.procedure: Lock/unlock, background/foreground, receive a call and switch apps mid-flow; UI and server state reconcile safely.

checks.title: Slow drag
checks.procedure: Drag each scrollable area slowly from top to bottom and back; movement follows the finger continuously with no sticking.

checks.title: Fast fling
checks.procedure: Flick and release repeatedly in both directions; deceleration remains continuous until a genuine content boundary, without unexplained stops.

checks.title: Reverse and interrupt
checks.procedure: Reverse a moving list and tap to stop momentum; the user takes control immediately without delayed forced repositioning.

checks.title: Scroll from any content
checks.procedure: Start a drag over text, cards, gaps, images and inactive controls; the intended region scrolls and a drag does not trigger a click.

checks.title: Nested scroll ownership
checks.procedure: Exercise page, list, textarea, sheet and inner preview boundaries; the correct container receives input without accidental page movement.

checks.title: Short and empty content
checks.procedure: Test zero, one and screenful-minus-one items; no phantom scroll area, stuck gesture or unreachable action appears.

checks.title: Long content boundaries
checks.procedure: Reach the true first and last items of large datasets; no invisible end wall or permanently blank tail occurs.

checks.title: Horizontal versus vertical gestures
checks.procedure: Swipe segmented tabs, carousels and date strips diagonally; horizontal interaction and vertical scrolling do not steal each other unpredictably.

checks.title: Native edge navigation
checks.procedure: Test supported edge-back gestures alongside horizontal content; navigation and scrolling remain distinguishable and recoverable.

checks.title: Overscroll behavior
checks.procedure: Pull beyond both ends of each region; bounce and scroll chaining follow the intended surface behavior without revealing blank app background.

checks.title: One scroll owner per region
checks.procedure: Inspect ancestor overflow and actual scrolling elements; avoid competing full-page and inner-page scrollers for the same content.

checks.title: Scroll position on return
checks.procedure: Open an item, return, switch tabs and reopen; restore the intended item and offset rather than jumping unexpectedly to the top.

checks.title: Late layout changes
checks.procedure: Load images, fonts, expanded cards and error banners while reading; the visible content anchor remains stable.

checks.title: Data refresh during a fling
checks.procedure: Trigger polling/refetch while momentum is active; rows do not resize, remount or reset scroll position mid-gesture.

checks.title: Repeated scroll setters
checks.procedure: Trace scrollTop, scrollTo and scrollIntoView calls; incidental renders and query responses do not issue unsolicited position changes.

checks.title: Programmatic versus user scrolling
checks.procedure: Trigger auto-navigation and then manually drag; programmatic events do not falsely overwrite user intent or repeatedly fight the gesture.

checks.title: Scroll snap review
checks.procedure: Where snapping is used, fling slowly and quickly past multiple items; the intended stop is reachable and no snap trap clips content.

checks.title: Listener cancellation
checks.procedure: Inspect touchmove/wheel listeners and preventDefault usage; blocking handlers are narrowly justified and native pan remains available.

checks.title: Gesture CSS
checks.procedure: Inspect touch-action across ancestors; pan-y, pan-x and none do not accidentally disable required gestures or accessibility zoom.

checks.title: Flex and grid sizing
checks.procedure: Inspect actual scroll container bounds, min-height and overflow; content shrinks inside the viewport rather than pushing the composer offscreen.

checks.title: Zoom and browser chrome
checks.procedure: Zoom where supported and expand/collapse Safari chrome; no stranded content, double scrollbars or unexplained viewport gaps remain.

checks.title: Repeated navigation stress
checks.procedure: Visit, scroll and leave the same pages 30 times; no accumulating listeners, body locks or degraded response occurs.

checks.title: Screen-reader scrolling
checks.procedure: Navigate and scroll using VoiceOver; offscreen content becomes reachable and focus does not point at recycled invisible rows.

checks.title: Physical performance trace
checks.procedure: Record a representative long fling on real hardware with Instruments/Web Inspector; correlate any stutter with main-thread work and layout changes.

checks.title: First and last form fields
checks.procedure: Focus fields near both screen edges; the field, error and next required action remain reachable above the keyboard.

checks.title: Chat composer visibility
checks.procedure: Open the keyboard in a long thread; input and send action stay usable without covering the latest visible message.

checks.title: Keyboard dismissal
checks.procedure: Dismiss with Done, tap-away and supported drag gesture; layout returns without a persistent empty gap or locked page.

checks.title: Keyboard switching
checks.procedure: Switch emoji, dictation, numeric, third-party and language keyboards where available; variable heights do not clip the composer.

checks.title: Multiline composer
checks.procedure: Type and paste many lines; the input grows to a defined maximum then scrolls internally without consuming the entire conversation.

checks.title: Autofill and password managers
checks.procedure: Fill login, contact and address data; no unintended zoom, blocked submit or incorrect value bypass occurs.

checks.title: Hardware keyboard
checks.procedure: Tab, Shift-Tab, arrows, Enter and Escape work where appropriate; focus is visible and required actions need no touch.

checks.title: Sheet with keyboard
checks.procedure: Open, scroll and close a sheet while a field is focused; keyboard and focus are restored sensibly and the body unlocks.

checks.title: Nested checkout fields
checks.procedure: Focus Stripe-hosted fields and validation errors; iframe focus remains visible and no app-level resize hides payment controls.

checks.title: Safe-area accounting
checks.procedure: Inspect top, bottom and landscape insets on physical devices; apply each inset once and avoid doubled home-indicator padding.

checks.title: Visual versus layout viewport
checks.procedure: Log visualViewport height/offset and element bounds during keyboard transitions; do not assume 100dvh alone solves keyboard occlusion.

checks.title: Resize implementation
checks.procedure: Verify the actual installed native keyboard handling and resize mode; CSS and native resizing do not both subtract keyboard height.

checks.title: Keyboard lifecycle cleanup
checks.procedure: Navigate away during show/hide transitions; listeners and timers clean up and the next screen receives normal scroll behavior.

checks.title: Text entry semantics
checks.procedure: Test IME composition, autocorrect, paste, undo and selection; Enter does not send an unfinished composition or lose characters.

checks.title: Continuous agenda fling
checks.procedure: Fling across many dates in both directions; the calendar continues decelerating without stopping at artificial day or month boundaries.

checks.title: Virtual window boundaries
checks.procedure: Traverse near both ends of the virtualized range; any rebasing preserves the visible day and within-day offset after movement settles.

checks.title: Touch held during idle gap
checks.procedure: Hold the finger stationary, then resume dragging; an idle timer must not rebase or steal the active gesture.

checks.title: Scroll end fallback
checks.procedure: Test platforms with and without scrollend behavior; fallback timing does not mistake a brief event gap for the end of momentum.

checks.title: Pending data while moving
checks.procedure: Fetch another month or receive a booking during a fling; layout updates do not cancel inertia or temporarily erase appointments.

checks.title: Sparse and dense days
checks.procedure: Alternate empty days with heavily booked days; row measurement and spacers remain accurate and every appointment is reachable.

checks.title: Expand and collapse agenda
checks.procedure: Switch compact/expanded rows at different scroll positions; the same date stays anchored and content does not overlap.

checks.title: Today action
checks.procedure: Tap Today while far away and while coasting; land on the actual local today once, with matching selected date and header.

checks.title: Date picker and arrows
checks.procedure: Choose a date and use previous/next controls; explicit navigation works even when selecting the already active date.

checks.title: Scroll-driven header updates
checks.procedure: Scroll slowly across day/month boundaries; headers reflect visible dates without triggering a feedback loop that scrolls again.

checks.title: Appointment interaction
checks.procedure: Tap a moving or stationary appointment; only a deliberate tap opens the correct details and closing preserves calendar position.

checks.title: Calendar return and rotation
checks.procedure: Open booking details, rotate and return; selected day, filters and sensible offset survive without broken virtualization.

checks.title: One dismissal control
checks.procedure: Inspect every overlay state; exactly one intended close control appears for the active sheet, with an accessible name.

checks.title: Close behaviors
checks.procedure: Exercise close icon, Cancel, back, Escape and permitted backdrop dismissal; each closes the intended layer only.

checks.title: Protected unsaved edits
checks.procedure: Dismiss a dirty form by every supported route; changes are saved, retained or discarded according to the same stated policy.

checks.title: Portal placement
checks.procedure: Open overlays from messages and scrollable cards; they render outside clipped/transformed ancestors and cover the intended viewport.

checks.title: Background scroll lock
checks.procedure: Scroll an open sheet at both boundaries; background content stays still while sheet content remains reachable.

checks.title: Lock cleanup
checks.procedure: Close via every route, navigate away and trigger an error; body scrolling and styles are fully restored.

checks.title: Nested overlays
checks.procedure: Open a picker/lightbox from a sheet; only the top layer handles input and closing it restores the underlying sheet.

checks.title: Safe-area close button
checks.procedure: Test all orientations and keyboard states; close and primary actions never sit under browser chrome, notch or home indicator.

checks.title: Focus confinement
checks.procedure: With keyboard and VoiceOver, focus stays inside a modal and returns to a sensible trigger after close.

checks.title: Long overlay content
checks.procedure: Test large text and many fields; header/footer remain usable and the final item is not behind a fixed action bar.

checks.title: Animation interruptions
checks.procedure: Open/close rapidly and navigate mid-animation; no invisible backdrop, stranded focus or duplicate portal remains.

checks.title: Layer order
checks.procedure: Show toast, navigation, composer, sheet and lightbox together; the documented stacking order holds without inaccessible alerts.

checks.title: Full-width subheader tabs
checks.procedure: Compare Overview/Messages/Files/Payment and Today/Clients/Supplies patterns; segmented controls span usable iPhone width between shared content gutters.

checks.title: Shared header geometry
checks.procedure: Overlay screenshots at the same viewport; repeated title, back button, action and subtitle positions use the same tokens.

checks.title: Shared component dimensions
checks.procedure: Compare button heights, row spacing, radii, icon sizes, dividers and card padding across routes; variants are intentional and documented.

checks.title: Safe touch spacing
checks.procedure: Measure effective hit areas, including close/send icons; use a 44-by-44 logical-unit product target and adequate spacing, not just visible icon size.

checks.title: Loading geometry
checks.procedure: Replace loaded content with skeletons and pending states; surrounding controls do not jump or become easy to mis-tap.

checks.title: Text extremes
checks.procedure: Use long names, multiline titles, emoji, unbroken strings and missing avatars; content wraps or truncates intentionally without covering actions.

checks.title: Theme states
checks.procedure: Check light/dark/system changes while the app is open; surfaces, native keyboard, status bar and disabled states remain legible.

checks.title: State styling
checks.procedure: Inspect default, pressed, focused, selected, disabled, loading and error variants; all remain visually distinct and consistent.

checks.title: Empty and error layouts
checks.procedure: Compare empty lists, access denied, no results and offline pages; copy explains the next action and spacing matches the design system.

checks.title: Motion settings
checks.procedure: Enable Reduce Motion; nonessential animations reduce and required state changes remain understandable.

checks.title: Screen edge clipping
checks.procedure: Scroll every page to the bottom and rotate; no clipped text, horizontal page overflow or content hidden by fixed navigation.

checks.title: Visual regression review
checks.procedure: Compare approved screenshots for each shared component and key route at fixed device settings; review differences rather than blindly updating baselines.

title: Every button, tab, toggle, slider and link

checks.title: Label-to-outcome contract
checks.procedure: For each control write what a reasonable user expects, activate it and inspect UI plus persisted result; wording and behavior agree.

checks.title: Buttons with no effect
checks.procedure: Activate every enabled button in each role/state; it produces the promised action or visible explanation, never silence.

checks.title: Navigation actions
checks.procedure: Open every link and back path including refresh/deep link; the intended page loads with correct context and authorization.

checks.title: Tabs
checks.procedure: Select each tab by touch and keyboard; selected state, panel content, accessible state and URL/state retention agree.

checks.title: Settings switches
checks.procedure: Toggle both ways, reload and sign in on another device; the saved setting and actual feature behavior match.

checks.title: Filters versus settings
checks.procedure: Change a temporary filter and a permanent preference; scope and persistence match their labels without unexpected server changes.

checks.title: Sliders and ranges
checks.procedure: Test endpoints, increments, keyboard steps, drag cancellation and numeric entry if offered; stored values match display and allowed bounds.

checks.title: Checkboxes and radio groups
checks.procedure: Select labels as well as controls; exclusivity, tri-state if used, validation and persisted values are correct.

checks.title: Dropdowns and menus
checks.procedure: Open near viewport edges and with keyboard visible; every option can be reached, selected and dismissed without clipping.

checks.title: Disabled controls
checks.procedure: Trigger the state that disables a control; its reason is discoverable and it cannot mutate through keyboard or repeated tap.

checks.title: Pending actions
checks.procedure: Tap twice rapidly and retry after timeout; one logical action is performed and feedback remains visible.

checks.title: Dangerous actions
checks.procedure: Test delete, revoke, decline, disconnect and cancel; wording identifies the affected record and recovery/confirmation matches risk.

checks.title: Search and clear
checks.procedure: Enter, modify and clear searches including no results; results update correctly and clearing restores the expected list.

checks.title: Counter and quantity controls
checks.procedure: Test zero, min, max, stock change and repeated taps; boundaries hold on client and server.

checks.title: External system actions
checks.procedure: Share, copy, email, call, download and map links perform the named action; unsupported/cancelled actions show appropriate feedback.

checks.title: Control coverage completeness
checks.procedure: Compare executed control records against the route/state inventory; unresolved and unreachable controls are explicitly reported.

checks.title: Required and optional fields
checks.procedure: Submit empty and partial forms; required fields are identified and optional fields truly permit omission.

checks.title: Server validation
checks.procedure: Bypass client validation and submit malformed values; the server rejects safely with useful field-level errors.

checks.title: Boundary values
checks.procedure: Test minimum/maximum length, zero, negatives, decimals, Unicode, whitespace and impossible dates; accepted data remains valid.

checks.title: Accessible errors
checks.procedure: Submit invalid data; errors identify the field, preserve input and move/announce focus sensibly without hiding the correction.

checks.title: Draft isolation
checks.procedure: Write drafts in two threads or accounts; drafts persist where promised and never appear in the wrong context.

checks.title: Save versus cancel
checks.procedure: Edit and cancel, then reopen; Cancel preserves old values while Save persists exactly the intended fields.

checks.title: Unsaved navigation
checks.procedure: Refresh, go back, close the app and reopen mid-form; retention behavior is explicit and consistent.

checks.title: Concurrent edits
checks.procedure: Edit the same record on two devices; stale updates do not silently overwrite important new data.

checks.title: Autofill normalization
checks.procedure: Paste formatted phone numbers, currency and email addresses; normalization is visible and does not corrupt valid input.

checks.title: Repeated submissions
checks.procedure: Submit on slow network, press Enter and tap Save; deduplication prevents duplicate records.

checks.title: Upload validation
checks.procedure: Test oversized, unsupported, damaged and misleadingly named files; server-side checks reject safely and allow retry.

checks.title: Date/time input
checks.procedure: Test locale formats, midnight and timezone changes; stored instants and displayed local times agree.

checks.title: Registration lifecycle
checks.procedure: Complete all supported sign-up paths and verify email/identity as required; incomplete accounts cannot bypass required steps.

checks.title: Login and recovery
checks.procedure: Test correct/wrong credentials, reset links, expired links and reuse; errors are useful without revealing account existence unnecessarily.

checks.title: OAuth return paths
checks.procedure: Cancel, deny, retry and return from provider login; sessions and original destinations are restored safely.

checks.title: Session expiry
checks.procedure: Expire authentication during a form, chat send and checkout; reauthentication preserves safe work without replaying a charge.

checks.title: Logout isolation
checks.procedure: Log out then use back, cached routes and another account; prior private content and credentials are unavailable.

checks.title: Cross-account access
checks.procedure: Substitute conversation, order, client, appointment and file IDs; server authorization rejects access outside the user's scope.

checks.title: Role and tier changes
checks.procedure: Change artist/client/studio privileges and subscription tier during a session; server enforcement updates without relying on cached UI.

checks.title: Suspended/deleted users
checks.procedure: Reuse old tokens and deep links; revoked accounts cannot continue private mutations or retrieve restricted data.

checks.title: Account deletion
checks.procedure: Request deletion through the supported flow; completion, retention exceptions and integrations follow the approved policy with auditable status.

checks.title: Abuse protection
checks.procedure: Exercise login/send/upload limits in staging; rate limiting protects resources without permanently trapping legitimate users.

title: Messages, realtime and notifications in threads

checks.title: Send ordinary text
checks.procedure: Send from each participant; one bubble appears immediately, persists after reload and reaches the intended recipient.

checks.title: Pending versus confirmed
checks.procedure: Delay the send request; UI distinguishes pending from confirmed and never claims delivery/read status without evidence.

checks.title: Poll during send
checks.procedure: Let a message-list refresh finish while sending; the pending or saved message does not vanish or duplicate.

checks.title: Failure and retry
checks.procedure: Fail the send, reconnect and retry; the draft remains recoverable and exactly one persisted message results.

checks.title: Recipient reading history
checks.procedure: Receive messages while scrolled up; reading position remains stable and new-message indication provides a route to the latest content.

checks.title: Sender reading history
checks.procedure: Send while scrolled up; show the new message intentionally once without ongoing forced scrolling.

checks.title: Long thread paging
checks.procedure: Load older messages and pass page boundaries; chronological ordering and visible anchor remain stable with no gaps or duplicates.

checks.title: Equal timestamps
checks.procedure: Send several messages rapidly from both users; deterministic ordering survives polling and reload.

checks.title: Draft while sending
checks.procedure: Type a second draft before the first request finishes; success clears only the sent draft and preserves newer text.

checks.title: Images and attachments
checks.procedure: Send, preview, cancel, fail and retry supported attachments; ownership, dimensions, loading and download access remain correct.

checks.title: Structured messages
checks.procedure: Exercise proposal, session plan, payment receipt, invite and reference grids; each renders useful content and valid actions.

checks.title: Read/unread semantics
checks.procedure: Open, background and leave a conversation; unread badges and read receipts change only according to documented visibility rules.

checks.title: Thread switching race
checks.procedure: Send in thread A and switch to B before completion; callbacks, cache updates and drafts stay in A.

checks.title: Reconnect and multi-device
checks.procedure: Disconnect one participant, send elsewhere, then resume; missed messages reconcile once without relying only on push delivery.

checks.title: Malformed legacy content
checks.procedure: Load missing metadata and older message shapes; the thread stays usable and offers a safe fallback.

checks.title: Public request
checks.procedure: Submit a booking request including service, references and availability; the intended artist receives all selected details.

checks.title: Create proposal
checks.procedure: Create single and multiple-session proposals; dates, duration, price, deposit and recipient match the review screen.

checks.title: Accept/decline/revoke
checks.procedure: Exercise each valid action and repeat it; lifecycle transitions are authorized, consistent and idempotent.

checks.title: Availability collision
checks.procedure: Book the same time concurrently from two sessions; conflicting reservations cannot both become confirmed.

checks.title: Working hours
checks.procedure: Edit weekly hours, breaks and exceptions; availability and public booking choices reflect saved values.

checks.title: Timezone and DST
checks.procedure: Test Brisbane, a DST-observing zone, midnight and DST transitions; calendar dates and server instants remain unambiguous.

checks.title: Reschedule
checks.procedure: Move a pending and confirmed appointment, including conflict cases; old slot, new slot and notifications reconcile correctly.

checks.title: Price after payment
checks.procedure: Change prices before and after partial payment; paid value stays intact and remaining balance never becomes inconsistent or negative.

checks.title: Batch edits
checks.procedure: Apply changes to eligible future bookings; scope is clearly shown and failures do not leave unintended partial updates.

checks.title: Cancel and no-show
checks.procedure: Exercise supported cancellation/no-show paths; financial consequences and availability match the approved policy.

checks.title: Completion
checks.procedure: Complete a session and attempt invalid repeated transitions; history, balance and reporting remain consistent.

checks.title: Waitlist offers
checks.procedure: Offer, accept, expire and decline a slot; concurrent claimants cannot overbook and acceptance wording matches any payment step.

checks.title: Multi-session consistency
checks.procedure: Cancel or reschedule one sitting; other sessions and aggregate deposit/balance calculations remain correct.

checks.title: External calendar if enabled
checks.procedure: Create, update and remove synced events; timezone, deduplication, permission expiry and disconnect are handled.

checks.title: Authoritative pricing
checks.procedure: Tamper with client totals, currency, tier and seller; the server derives authorized price and fee values independently.

checks.title: Fee formula
checks.procedure: Reconcile shared/fees.ts with approved product policy; deposit, balance and shopfront use the intended single source of truth.

checks.title: Minimum fee boundary
checks.procedure: Test amounts below, at and above the floor crossover; integer-cent rounding is consistent on screen, Stripe and ledger.

checks.title: Tier matrix
checks.procedure: Test Free, Pro, Studio and legacy aliases; customer fee, artist fee and entitlements resolve correctly.

checks.title: Deposit then balance
checks.procedure: Pay both stages separately; each stage uses the intended fee policy without charging the deposit twice or hiding the second fee.

checks.title: Total disclosure
checks.procedure: Compare review, payment sheet, charge and receipt; item/service amount, shipping, fees and any tax add up exactly.

checks.title: Connect destination
checks.procedure: Inspect the real sandbox payment objects; charge destination and application fee belong to the correct connected artist/store.

checks.title: Connected-account readiness
checks.procedure: Test incomplete onboarding, disabled charges and restricted payouts; checkout is blocked or guided without falsely showing ready status.

checks.title: Successful card payment
checks.procedure: Complete a sandbox charge and inspect database plus recipient view; confirmation follows authoritative payment state.

checks.title: Declined card
checks.procedure: Use documented decline scenarios; booking/order stays unpaid and retry does not reserve or charge twice.

checks.title: Authentication challenge
checks.procedure: Complete, fail and cancel 3DS; return routes restore correct state and no false confirmation appears.

checks.title: Apple Pay
checks.procedure: Test supported physical devices and configured domains/native surfaces; amount, merchant label, cancellation and return behavior are correct.

checks.title: Slow or lost response
checks.procedure: Lose connectivity after confirmation; reconciliation finds the existing payment rather than creating another charge.

checks.title: Duplicate payment requests
checks.procedure: Double tap, refresh and submit concurrently; server idempotency protects the same logical payment.

checks.title: Expired payment link
checks.procedure: Open expired, revoked, reused and wrong-account links; protected details and further payments are handled safely.

checks.title: Zero and invalid amounts
checks.procedure: Test free/fully paid, negative, excessive and malformed totals; no meaningless charge or unexplained fee is created.

checks.title: Change during checkout
checks.procedure: Change price, stock or connected account while a sheet is open; stale sessions cannot silently charge the wrong amount or seller.

checks.title: Cancellation return
checks.procedure: Back out before and after authorization; the app distinguishes cancelled, processing and succeeded states accurately.

checks.title: Webhook authenticity
checks.procedure: Send invalid signatures and mismatched environments; untrusted events cannot mutate payment state.

checks.title: Duplicate webhook
checks.procedure: Deliver the same event repeatedly; only one settlement, stock deduction, booking confirmation and ledger effect occurs.

checks.title: Out-of-order events
checks.procedure: Deliver processing/success/refund events in changed order; state never regresses incorrectly.

checks.title: Delayed webhook
checks.procedure: Hold delivery after payment confirmation; UI shows reconciliation/processing and eventually converges without another payment.

checks.title: Webhook failure retry
checks.procedure: Fail the worker or database, then retry; durable processing resumes and alerts expose stuck events.

checks.title: Atomic settlement
checks.procedure: Interrupt between ledger, booking/order and stock changes; transaction boundaries or recovery prevent partial financial state.

checks.title: Amount and currency match
checks.procedure: Send an otherwise valid event for mismatched payment metadata; reconciliation rejects or quarantines it rather than settling another record.

checks.title: Full refund
checks.procedure: Refund a paid test transaction; customer refund, booking/order status, ledger and intended fee/transfer reversals agree.

checks.title: Partial refund
checks.procedure: Refund part of a payment repeatedly within bounds; cumulative refunds cannot exceed collected funds and balances remain correct.

checks.title: Dispute handling
checks.procedure: Simulate a dispute; platform liability, ledger state, user-facing status and operational notifications follow policy.

checks.title: Payout reconciliation
checks.procedure: Compare connected balances and payout records with the app; pending, available, paid and failed are distinct.

checks.title: Payout failure
checks.procedure: Test rejected or paused payouts; no paid-out success is shown until authoritative confirmation.

checks.title: Subscription lifecycle
checks.procedure: Test trial if offered, renewal, failure, cancellation, upgrade and downgrade; entitlements follow the approved effective dates.

checks.title: Finance audit trail
checks.procedure: Trace one transaction end to end through stable IDs; support can explain gross amount, both fees, refund and destination without sensitive card data.

checks.title: Dedicated shopfront route
checks.procedure: Open Shopfront from profile, map and a direct link; it opens the actual shop page for the selected seller.

checks.title: Catalog completeness
checks.procedure: Compare published products with database visibility; drafts, archived and private items do not leak publicly.

checks.title: Filters and search
checks.procedure: Combine search, category and in-stock filters; results and counts match the selected criteria with a useful empty state.

checks.title: Product detail
checks.procedure: Open every supported product type; description, images, price, variant and availability match the selected item.

checks.title: Variant selection
checks.procedure: Change options and add to cart; the correct SKU, price and stock are retained rather than the first variant.

checks.title: Stock boundaries
checks.procedure: Add the last item simultaneously from two clients; server enforcement prevents overselling or reports a clear reservation outcome.

checks.title: Cart arithmetic
checks.procedure: Add, increment, decrement and remove mixed items; quantity limits and totals remain consistent after reload.

checks.title: Store isolation
checks.procedure: Visit another seller with an existing cart; items are not silently charged to the wrong store or mixed against policy.

checks.title: Fulfillment choice
checks.procedure: Switch collection/shipping and update address; allowed options, shipping price and validation reflect the choice.

checks.title: Checkout completion
checks.procedure: Complete a real sandbox order; order confirmation, stock deduction, seller order list and buyer purchase history agree.

checks.title: Order actions
checks.procedure: Fulfill, cancel and refund where supported; state and customer-facing tracking match the exact action.

checks.title: Unavailable products
checks.procedure: Unpublish or change stock while an item is in a cart; checkout explains the change and updates safely.

checks.title: Studio invitations
checks.procedure: Invite, accept, decline, expire and reuse a link; membership is authorized and created once.

checks.title: Member permissions
checks.procedure: Test owner, artist and other configured roles; private clients, finances and settings respect the server permission model.

checks.title: Artist assignment
checks.procedure: Reassign a booking where supported; calendar, owner access, notifications and payment destination remain coherent.

checks.title: Artist filtering
checks.procedure: Filter calendars and lists by artist; counts and records reflect the filter and reset correctly.

checks.title: Member removal
checks.procedure: Remove a member with active bookings; future access and historical records follow a documented transition policy.

checks.title: Client records
checks.procedure: Create, edit, search and merge if offered; duplicates and private notes are handled safely with stable identity.

checks.title: Private notes
checks.procedure: Verify notes never leak into public profile, client chat, exports intended for others or push previews.

checks.title: Supplies and stock
checks.procedure: Change supplies, quantities and reorder status; calculations persist and units remain explicit.

checks.title: Travel and availability
checks.procedure: Add guest spots or travel dates; location and scheduling restrictions propagate correctly.

checks.title: Data imports
checks.procedure: Import valid, duplicate and malformed files; preview, error reporting, limits and rollback prevent silent corruption.

checks.title: Required consent rules
checks.procedure: Have the responsible domain owner approve applicable jurisdiction and age requirements; version the policy tested for this release.

checks.title: Form completeness
checks.procedure: Submit incomplete and invalid required consent data; completion cannot be forged by changing client state.

checks.title: Signer and booking association
checks.procedure: Complete a form and retrieve it later; signature, signer, booking, artist and policy version remain correctly linked.

checks.title: Record immutability
checks.procedure: Attempt to alter a finalized form; amendments are tracked without silently rewriting the historical consent record.

checks.title: Sensitive file access
checks.procedure: Try public URLs and another account; forms and identity records require authorized access and appropriately scoped links.

checks.title: Export correctness
checks.procedure: Download a completed record; all required fields, timestamps and content render accurately without clipped signatures.

checks.title: Retention and deletion
checks.procedure: Test the approved retention exceptions and deletion workflow; access restrictions and audit records remain consistent.

checks.title: Interrupted signing
checks.procedure: Close or disconnect mid-form; partial progress and final submission are distinguishable and recoverable.

checks.title: Feed navigation
checks.procedure: Scroll many items, open an artist and return; position, selected content and video playback remain sensible.

checks.title: Video resource lifecycle
checks.procedure: Play, pause, swipe away and background repeatedly; offscreen videos release resources and audio does not continue unexpectedly.

checks.title: Media failure
checks.procedure: Load missing, slow and corrupted images/video; placeholders preserve layout and the feed stays responsive.

checks.title: Mute and playback
checks.procedure: Toggle mute, play and any playback controls; icon state matches actual sound and playback.

checks.title: Likes and saves
checks.procedure: Toggle rapidly and offline; final persisted state matches the user action without duplicate counts.

checks.title: Sharing
checks.procedure: Share a public item and open the link signed out; the intended content appears without exposing private data.

checks.title: Artist/contact visibility
checks.procedure: Change publication settings and inspect all public surfaces; hidden services and contact details remain private.

checks.title: Location permission
checks.procedure: Allow, deny and revoke geolocation; map and near-me features remain usable with accurate explanations.

checks.title: Map interaction
checks.procedure: Pan, zoom, open a marker and select its actions; correct artist/route opens and zero-valued coordinates work.

checks.title: Marketing consent
checks.procedure: Opt in and out of each offered channel; delivery respects saved preferences and consent records.

checks.title: Campaign targeting
checks.procedure: Preview audience and send only to test recipients in staging; filters, exclusions and personalization select the intended recipients.

checks.title: Campaign reporting
checks.procedure: Compare delivered/opened/clicked metrics with provider definitions; missing or delayed tracking is not represented as certainty.

checks.title: Permission lifecycle
checks.procedure: Accept, deny and later revoke notifications; the app reflects system state without repeated coercive prompts.

checks.title: Device registration
checks.procedure: Log in/out and switch accounts on the same device; tokens belong only to the correct active recipient.

checks.title: Foreground behavior
checks.procedure: Receive a message while viewing its thread; avoid duplicate disruptive notifications and maintain correct unread state.

checks.title: Background and killed app
checks.procedure: Tap notifications in each lifecycle state; open the exact authorized thread/booking after any required login.

checks.title: Stale notification
checks.procedure: Open a notification for deleted/revoked content; show a useful unavailable state rather than a crash or private leak.

checks.title: Payload privacy
checks.procedure: Inspect lock-screen previews and logged payloads; sensitive notes, consent and payment data are not disclosed.

checks.title: Notification preferences
checks.procedure: Disable individual categories; provider delivery, in-app indicators and saved settings match the promised scope.

checks.title: Integration authorization
checks.procedure: Connect, cancel consent, expire credentials and reconnect; partial setup never reports Connected prematurely.

checks.title: Disconnect integration
checks.procedure: Disconnect and attempt another operation; tokens/jobs are revoked and UI offers a safe reconnect path.

checks.title: Provider outage
checks.procedure: Simulate timeout, rate limit and invalid response; retries back off and the app explains what remains pending.

checks.title: VoiceOver journey
checks.procedure: Complete registration, booking, messaging and checkout with VoiceOver; names, roles, values and reading order support independent use.

checks.title: Focus visibility
checks.procedure: Navigate with a hardware keyboard; focus remains visible and is not hidden by sticky headers, sheets or the keyboard.

checks.title: Text enlargement
checks.procedure: Test platform accessibility text sizes and browser zoom; essential content reflows and actions remain usable.

checks.title: Contrast audit
checks.procedure: Measure text, icons, boundaries and focus across themes/states against the chosen WCAG target; automated checks are supplemented manually.

checks.title: Control names
checks.procedure: Inspect icon-only and repeated buttons; accessible labels distinguish their purpose and associated record.

checks.title: State announcements
checks.procedure: Change tabs, switches, validation, pending payments and incoming messages; assistive feedback is useful without repeatedly reading the entire page.

checks.title: Non-color cues
checks.procedure: Inspect paid/unpaid, availability, errors and selected items in grayscale; text or shape conveys the same meaning.

checks.title: Alternative to drag
checks.procedure: Complete any reorder, slider or calendar drag task without dragging where applicable; equivalent controls remain available.

checks.title: Focus after removal
checks.procedure: Delete an item or close a modal; focus moves to a predictable surviving element, not the document beginning.

checks.title: Reduced motion and transparency
checks.procedure: Enable platform preferences; content remains readable and nonessential movement is reduced.

checks.title: Touch target audit
checks.procedure: Check measured interactive areas and spacing; product touch targets and WCAG exceptions are documented separately.

checks.title: Error recovery accessibility
checks.procedure: Trigger network and validation failures using assistive tech; retry and correction are reachable and clearly associated.

checks.title: Offline start
checks.procedure: Open without connectivity on first and subsequent launches; show a useful state instead of endless loading.

checks.title: Offline mutations
checks.procedure: Send, save and book offline; indicate failure or explicit queued state and never imply unconfirmed success.

checks.title: Reconnect replay
checks.procedure: Restore connectivity after retries; queued work is deduplicated and its final outcome is visible.

checks.title: Out-of-order responses
checks.procedure: Delay older searches/requests past newer ones; stale results do not replace current state.

checks.title: Abandoned routes
checks.procedure: Resolve requests after leaving a screen; callbacks do not navigate unexpectedly or overwrite another record.

checks.title: Cache isolation
checks.procedure: Switch users, studios and stores; query keys and persisted caches prevent cross-context data leakage.

checks.title: Server outage
checks.procedure: Exercise 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429 and 500 responses; each has appropriate recovery and no endless spinner.

checks.title: Malformed response
checks.procedure: Return missing/invalid data from a test API; errors are contained with safe fallbacks rather than blank screens.

checks.title: PWA upgrade
checks.procedure: Upgrade with old cached assets and open tabs; HTML, chunks and API compatibility remain coherent and unsaved work is protected.

checks.title: Force termination
checks.procedure: Kill the app during send, payment and upload then reopen; reconcile status before allowing unsafe retries.

checks.title: Storage unavailable
checks.procedure: Simulate full storage and storage API failure; drafts/preferences fail gracefully without breaking the entire app.

checks.title: Clock skew
checks.procedure: Change device time substantially; server-owned expiry, payment and authorization decisions remain correct.

checks.title: Cold and warm start
checks.procedure: Measure production builds on oldest and typical supported devices; compare against recorded release budgets and prior release.

checks.title: Input responsiveness
checks.procedure: Type, tap and navigate under realistic load; delayed feedback does not cause repeated submissions.

checks.title: Scrolling frame time
checks.procedure: Profile calendar, chat and feed under load; investigate sustained frame misses and long tasks against the device refresh rate.

checks.title: Large dataset behavior
checks.procedure: Use long threads, many appointments and products; rendering and queries remain bounded and all records stay reachable.

checks.title: Memory soak
checks.procedure: Repeat navigation, media playback and overlay cycles for at least 30 minutes; retained memory does not grow without bound.

checks.title: Background resource use
checks.procedure: Background the app during media and polling; battery/network work matches intended behavior and resumes correctly.

checks.title: Low-memory recovery
checks.procedure: Exercise memory pressure or WebView termination where tooling permits; restore a useful app state without private-data leakage.

checks.title: Image budgets
checks.procedure: Load large galleries over slow network; responsive sizing and lazy loading avoid unnecessary decoding and transfer costs.

checks.title: Network duplication
checks.procedure: Inspect requests during route changes and repeated rerenders; no runaway polling or redundant mutation traffic occurs.

checks.title: Web performance metrics
checks.procedure: Measure LCP, INP and CLS in appropriate field/lab contexts; record budgets and percentiles rather than quoting a single best run.

checks.title: Crash reporting
checks.procedure: Cause a controlled staging error; the report has build, stack and safe context without credentials or sensitive user content.

checks.title: Thermal and power conditions
checks.procedure: Test extended use and Low Power Mode on a real device; functionality remains correct under throttling.

checks.title: Threat model
checks.procedure: Identify assets, trust boundaries and abuse paths for client, API, files, payments and integrations; map relevant OWASP controls to tests.

checks.title: Secret exposure
checks.procedure: Scan repository, built bundles, source maps and logs; server secrets and private credentials are absent from client artifacts.

checks.title: Transport security
checks.procedure: Verify HTTPS, certificate validation and production native networking settings; insecure fallbacks are disabled.

checks.title: Token storage
checks.procedure: Review web/session and native credential storage; exposure, expiry and logout behavior match the threat model.

checks.title: Object-level authorization
checks.procedure: Enumerate protected APIs and change IDs/tenant values; ownership is enforced server-side for read and write operations.

checks.title: Injection
checks.procedure: Test user content rendered in chat, profiles, search and imports; scripts, SQL and unsafe markup cannot execute.

checks.title: CSRF and origin rules
checks.procedure: Verify protections for the actual authentication model and allowed origins; unrelated sites cannot initiate authorized mutations.

checks.title: Upload/storage security
checks.procedure: Check MIME validation, size limits, object ACLs and signed URL expiry; filenames and paths cannot escape intended storage.

checks.title: Logs and analytics
checks.procedure: Inspect telemetry, error reports and URLs; passwords, tokens, full card data and sensitive records are excluded.

checks.title: Dependency review
checks.procedure: Audit pinned dependencies and native plugins; exploitable findings have fixes or documented risk decisions.

checks.title: Privacy inventory
checks.procedure: Match actual collected data, SDK behavior, retention and sharing to privacy disclosures; undocumented collection is removed or disclosed.

checks.title: Abuse and moderation
checks.procedure: Where user-generated content requires it, test reporting/blocking and support handling; blocked users cannot bypass restrictions through direct API calls.

checks.title: Migration rehearsal
checks.procedure: Apply migrations to a production-shaped staging snapshot with synthetic/redacted data; constraints and existing workflows still work.

checks.title: Backup restoration
checks.procedure: Restore a recent backup into an isolated environment; verify records, files and financial links against the recovery objective.

checks.title: Backward compatibility
checks.procedure: Run old and new client versions against the rollout API/schema; staged deployment does not strand installed clients.

checks.title: Transaction rollback
checks.procedure: Inject failure mid-operation; multi-record writes preserve documented invariants or have tested recovery.

checks.title: Concurrent updates
checks.procedure: Race booking, stock, refund and membership changes; locks/versioning prevent invalid combined results.

checks.title: Money representation
checks.procedure: Verify integer minor units and currency at every persistence boundary; no float or legacy whole-dollar field corrupts canonical amounts.

checks.title: Timestamp consistency
checks.procedure: Check UTC storage, timezone conversion and ordering; daylight changes do not alter historical instants.

checks.title: Background jobs
checks.procedure: Restart workers with pending tasks; durable jobs resume without duplication and dead-letter work is visible.

checks.title: Query and connection limits
checks.procedure: Load-test expensive endpoints and database pools; overload fails predictably without exhausting all app requests.

checks.title: Audit trails
checks.procedure: Verify critical mutations record actor, target, time and result; logs support investigation without excessive personal data.

title: Native packaging, deployment and store readiness

checks.title: Reproducible build
checks.procedure: Build from the recorded candidate with lockfile and pinned tools; client, server and native artifacts correspond to the same intended release.

checks.title: Configuration separation
checks.procedure: Inspect resolved release settings; staging URLs, test keys, debug tools and fixture data cannot accidentally ship as production.

checks.title: Native web assets
checks.procedure: Run and verify Capacitor synchronization; packaged assets match the tested web build rather than an older dist directory.

checks.title: Signing and identity
checks.procedure: Validate bundle ID, entitlements, signing, version and build number; install the actual distributed archive successfully.

checks.title: Required permissions
checks.procedure: Check native usage descriptions and permission requests against actual features; denial flows remain functional.

checks.title: Privacy manifests
checks.procedure: Review required SDK manifests and declared API/data use against current Apple submission requirements and installed dependencies.

checks.title: Launch experience
checks.procedure: Test icon, splash, status bar and first screen after clean install and upgrade; no white-screen hang or obsolete branding appears.

checks.title: Universal/deep links
checks.procedure: Open supported URLs from email, messages and browser with app installed/not installed; routing and authentication preserve the target safely.

checks.title: Store content
checks.procedure: Compare screenshots, description, age rating, privacy/support URLs and review notes with the submitted build; no placeholder or inaccessible review flow remains.

checks.title: Payment-policy review
checks.procedure: Have the release owner assess physical services/products versus any digital subscriptions/features under current store rules; do not assume one payment policy fits all.

checks.title: Deployment migration order
checks.procedure: Rehearse application/schema/worker rollout and health checks; production startup fails clearly if required prerequisites are missing.

checks.title: Rollback
checks.procedure: Rehearse rollback or forward-fix for code, flags, schema compatibility and web caches; define who can execute and how success is verified.

checks.title: Monitoring and alerts
checks.procedure: Verify production dashboards for errors, latency, failed sends, payment reconciliation and jobs; alerts reach an accountable operator.

checks.title: Progressive rollout
checks.procedure: Define initial audience, monitoring period and halt conditions; expansion requires evidence, not just elapsed time.

checks.title: Customer support readiness
checks.procedure: Prepare known-issue notes, escalation paths and transaction lookup procedures; support can identify affected build and help recover safely.

checks.title: Client-to-artist lifecycle
checks.procedure: On two accounts/devices, request, discuss, propose, pay deposit, attend and pay balance; both parties see the same authoritative state.

checks.title: New artist activation
checks.procedure: Register, configure services/hours, complete Connect and publish profile/shop; a client can discover and transact successfully.

checks.title: Shop purchase journey
checks.procedure: Discover seller, select variant, adjust cart, choose fulfillment and pay; buyer receipt, seller order and ledger reconcile.

checks.title: Message reliability journey
checks.procedure: Send through slow/offline/reconnect conditions, switch threads and reopen app; no message disappears, duplicates or reaches the wrong person.

checks.title: Calendar usability journey
checks.procedure: Scroll far, navigate Today, open/edit booking and return with keyboard/sheet interactions; momentum, dates and anchors remain usable.

checks.title: Studio journey
checks.procedure: Invite an artist, assign work and test restricted accounts; membership, calendar and private records respect approved boundaries.

checks.title: Cancellation/refund journey
checks.procedure: Cancel an eligible booking/order and refund the test payment; UI, customer view, ledger and Stripe agree.

checks.title: Accessibility journey
checks.procedure: Complete the critical customer path with VoiceOver and large text on a physical device; no essential step requires sight or precise dragging.

checks.title: Upgrade journey
checks.procedure: Start work in the previous release, upgrade and finish it; drafts, sessions, pending payments and cached state recover correctly.

checks.title: Incident recovery journey
checks.procedure: Interrupt a worker or provider in staging and recover it; queued work completes once and operations can identify any unresolved record.
